name: Datafast
summary: Telco (Datafast Telecommunications Ltd, ACN 073 238 178; ex-Goldminco NL, renamed Datafast Telecom 1999); took over Vivanet (2001); also sold ADSL products (resold via Swift Internet); became EFTel Ltd 2005.

events.details: Incorporated (Goldminco NL); renamed Datafast Telecommunications 5 Oct 1999.
Delisted 14 Jun 2013 (M2 acquisition); became EFTel Pty Ltd.
